During the game he informs the umpire of the decision of bringing in a substitute player and changing the position of a player. Only the captain is authorised to talk to the umpire.

paras.text: Catching the ball with both hands
paras.urdu: دونوں ہاتھوں سے بال کو پکڑنا

paras.text: Open the fingers of both hands; extending both arms towards the ball, as soon as the ball comes into the hands, take your body and arms backwards. In this way the ball, instead of bouncing in the hands, will be gripped correctly. To save the fingers from injury do not create stiffness in the fingers.

paras.text: Catching the ball with one hand
paras.urdu: ایک ہاتھ سے بال کو پکڑنا

paras.text: In this skill the player stretches out one arm and catches the ball with the same hand, because with one hand the ball can be caught even from a greater distance.
paras.urdu: اس مہارت میں کھلاڑی اپنا ایک بازو پھیلا کر اسی ہاتھ سے گیند پکڑتا ہے کیونکہ ایک ہاتھ سے گیند زیادہ دوری سے بھی پکڑا جا سکتا ہے۔
paras.pashto: په دې مهارت کې لوبغاړی یوه مټ غځوي او په همغه لاس توپ نیسي، ځکه په یوه لاس توپ له ډېر لرې هم نیول کېدای شي.

sections.theory:
… before, they enter the names of the players on the score sheet. When the umpire asks, they tell the account of the centre pass.

Time Keeper

For every game two time keepers are appointed who record the time of the start of every part of the game and keep account of the duration of the game.

Team Captain

After winning the toss he informs the umpire about the choice of goal post and the decision of starting the game with the centre pass. During the game he informs the umpire of the decision of bringing in a substitute player and changing the position of a player. Only the captain is authorised to talk to the umpire.

Skills of netball

Catching the ball with both hands

Open the fingers of both hands; extending both arms towards the ball, as soon as the ball comes into the hands, take your body and arms backwards. In this way the ball, instead of bouncing in the hands, will be gripped correctly. To save the fingers from injury do not create stiffness in the fingers.

Catching the ball with one hand

In this skill the player stretches out one arm and catches the ball with the same hand, because with one hand the ball can be caught even from a greater distance.
